name: Capital Goods

mofsl_2qfy27.headline: Healthy ordering momentum, though margins remain under pressure
mofsl_2qfy27.read: Aggregate order inflow across the coverage universe rose 31% YoY: L&T inflow +28% and KPIL +222% among EPC, ABB and Siemens strong, KEC down 31% on a high base; T&D ordering improved as TBCB tendering ramped from Jul-26; defence ordering stayed subdued with a ramp-up likely in 2H. Aggregate EBITDA margin contracted 90bp YoY to 12.0% (versus MOFSL estimate of 12.9%) on commodity and logistics costs, forex, delayed pass-through and fixed-price contracts, though most companies improved sequentially; aggregate revenue growth was 17.3%, EBITDA growth 8.9% and PAT growth 21.6%. Guidance: L&T FY27 order inflow and revenue growth 10-12% with core E&C margin ~7.8%; BHEL (BHE) FY27 revenue +15%, margin ~28%, order inflow INR550b+; GVTD base ordering INR70-80b with HVDC execution from FY28. MOFSL upgraded Hitachi Energy and ABB to BUY and downgraded Thermax to Neutral.

unit_economics: Revenue = opening order book x execution ratio + in-year orders x conversion; EBITDA = revenue x (gross margin - fixed costs), with price-variation clauses and fixed-price exposure deciding commodity pass-through; HV transformers add MVA x realisation per MVA.

price_drivers.why: Base (repeatable) orders versus HVDC, group exports and one-off mega orders decide visibility; inflow +31% YoY in 2Q is the stock-level support.

price_drivers.driver: Gross margin on new orders versus legacy backlog
price_drivers.why: Fixed-price and low-margin legacy orders held aggregate EBITDA margin at 12.0%; improvement depends on pass-through and run-off of legacy projects.
Transmission awards lead OEM orders by ~1-4 months; defence procurement ramp in 2H is a timing swing.
Copper, silver, CRGO and EUR cost reach fixed-price orders with a lag; parent-invoiced imports at MNC subsidiaries hit margin directly.
Transformer and switchgear capacity additions can turn pricing; peer gross margin trends and shortening lead times are the early signal.

kpis.name: Order inflow, backlog and book-to-bill
kpis.definition: Orders booked in the period, closing order book on the company's definition, and inflow divided by revenue.
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Multiples for HV, defence and EPC names follow order momentum: KPIL +222% and L&T +28% inflow underpin forward revenue, while a drop (KEC -31%) forces estimate cuts. Book-to-bill under 1.0x for two quarters flags peak.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation with metric filter 'order inflow' or 'order book'; transcripts via search_research and get_qa for large-order commentary; broker results-update notes (Motilal Oswal tables carry 8 quarters). get_financials does not carry order data.
kpis.estimate_source: Order inflow has no Bloomberg consensus field; use broker models, company guidance (L&T 10-12% FY27, BHEL INR550b+, GVTD INR70-80b) from transcripts; get_consensus_estimates only for the resulting Sales.
kpis.traps: Companies define backlog differently (GVTD books HVDC on internal milestones, Siemens counts parent allocations and loco value adjustments); large single orders distort YoY; TARIL backlog excludes price variation.

kpis.name: Base inflow versus HVDC, group and mega orders
kpis.definition: Inflow ex HVDC, ex group/related-party export allocations and ex orders above 10% of trailing inflow.
kpis.formula: Inflow - HVDC - RPT export - orders >=10% of TTM inflow
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Base orders drive recurring revenue; a headline beat built on one large or group order does not repeat. Hitachi's Q1FY27 inflow was ~Rs34bn base plus ~Rs17bn HVDC export.
kpis.history_source: Transcripts and decks via get_investor_presentation (metric filter 'base orders'); call commentary via get_qa; related-party note in annual reports via read_library_document.
kpis.estimate_source: Broker models only (Ambit, Nomura, Axis); no consensus. Company guidance on base ordering (GVTD INR70-80b FY27).
kpis.traps: Definitions of 'large' differ; HVDC awards not booked by the company must stay in scenarios; group allocations are parent decisions.

kpis.name: EBITDA margin (house: ex other income, ex one-offs)
kpis.definition: Operating EBITDA on revenue from operations after removing treasury income, write-backs, unrealised FX/commodity MTM and exceptional charges.
kpis.formula: (Revenue - operating costs, ex OI and MTM) / revenue
kpis.why_it_moves_price: The 90bp YoY margin contraction to 12.0% against a 12.9% estimate was the main negative of the quarter; gradual improvement from scale and price hikes is the base case in most multiples.
kpis.history_source: get_financials (revenue, material cost, employee, other expenses, other income); get_investor_presentation metric filter 'EBITDA margin'; broker results notes for 8-quarter tables.
kpis.estimate_source: get_consensus_estimates for Bloomberg Sales/EBITDA/PAT/EPS; segment margins (HV, IS, PS, defence) from broker models and guidance (BHEL ~28%, LT core E&C ~7.8%).
kpis.traps: Hitachi EBITDA appears on three bases (14.6%, 16.0%, 17.0%); labour-code charge treated as exceptional by some, operating by ABB; segment margin may be EBIT, not EBITDA; PR EBITDA at CG includes other income.

kpis.name: Execution ratio and revenue growth versus backlog
kpis.definition: Revenue in the period divided by opening order book, plus revenue growth versus order growth.
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Slow execution of a large backlog (HVDC executes 6-54 months, <30% in two years) delays earnings; BEL, HAL and BDL surprises came from delivery timing and provision write-backs.
kpis.history_source: Derived from get_investor_presentation order book and get_financials revenue; delivery commentary in transcripts.
kpis.estimate_source: Broker models; guidance on revenue growth in transcripts (BHEL 15%, L&T 10-12%); get_consensus_estimates Sales as output.
kpis.traps: Delivery-based seasonality in defence PSUs (Q4 heavy); price-variation revenue inflates growth; mega contracts carved separately.

kpis.name: Net working capital days and OCF/EBITDA
kpis.definition: Inventory + receivables + contract assets - payables - advances, in days of revenue; operating cash flow over EBITDA.
kpis.formula: House NWC / TTM revenue x 365; OCF / EBITDA
kpis.why_it_moves_price: L&T's NWC-to-revenue target under 10% and advance-funded HVDC awards drive FCF; receivable stretch at EPC names (retention, state discoms) precedes derating.
kpis.history_source: get_financials balance sheet and cash flow (annual and half-yearly); investor presentation metric filter 'working capital'.
kpis.estimate_source: Company targets in transcripts (L&T <10%); broker models; no consensus field.
kpis.traps: Supplier finance outside borrowings; advances on one award flatter NWC; defence PSU advances inflate other income.

kpis.name: Defence order inflow and development versus production mix
kpis.definition: Defence orders won, unexecuted firm order book, and share of development revenue in sales.
kpis.formula: Firm order book / TTM defence revenue
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Defence ordering was subdued in 2Q with a 2H ramp likely; HAL, BEL, BDL and ZEN valuations assume the fast-track procurement conversion; timing misses compress multiples quickly.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation metric filter 'order book'; transcripts via get_qa for L1 wins and expected awards; annual reports for provisioning notes.
kpis.estimate_source: Management inflow guidance in transcripts (BEL, HAL); broker models; Bloomberg consensus covers Sales/EBITDA/PAT only.
kpis.traps: Provision write-backs and price catch-ups inflate PSU margins; advance float income in other income; negotiated versus firm orders.

kpis.name: Capacity, lead times and pricing in HV equipment
kpis.definition: Operating MVA, utilisation, lead times in months and gross margin on new orders versus legacy.
kpis.formula: MVA produced / average operating MVA; gross margin trend
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Industry transformer capacity ~460 to ~690 GVA by FY28 (PL) risks pricing; falling GVTD and Hitachi gross margin (about 41% and 43% in Q1FY27) is the early signal.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation metric filter 'MVA' and 'capacity'; transcripts for lead time commentary.
kpis.estimate_source: Capacity guidance in transcripts; broker models (Ambit, Axis); no consensus field.
kpis.traps: Installed versus operating MVA (TARIL 40,200 vs 75,000); MVA is misleading across kV classes.

macro_inputs.series: NCT/TBCB awards, CEA GVA added, PGCIL capex
macro_inputs.source: Broker sector reports in the library; company transcripts
Broker notes in the library (MOFSL sector update)

macro_inputs.series: Government defence capex and fast-track procurement
macro_inputs.why: Timing of PSU and private defence orders

valuation_anchor: P/E on core EPS against own band (50-75x for HV leaders in the upcycle, lower for EPC); EV/EBITDA for L&T core and PSUs; order-book-adjusted SOTP by module.
watch_next_quarter: Per MOFSL, watch margin improvement as new capacity scales and price hikes pass through, L&T's 10-12% inflow target, ramp-up in defence ordering in 2H, TBCB-led T&D awards, GVTD HVDC execution from FY28 and BHEL's ~28% margin guide.
